name: Just The Gist
tagline: **Just The Gist** turns YouTube videos, podcasts, lectures, and any local audio or video file into clean transcripts and sharp, structured summaries…
description: **Just The Gist** turns YouTube videos, podcasts, lectures, and any local audio or video file into clean transcripts and sharp, structured summaries — TL;DR, key topics, the stuff you actually wanted from that 2-hour interview. The twist: **it's 100% local by default**. Whisper transcribes on-device and a built-in local model summarizes right on your Mac — no account, no API key, no credit card, and your audio never leaves your machine. Want more horsepower?
